card.line: The Salt Sea is a large inland sea east of Jerusalem where the Jordan River ends. In the Bible it marks the edge of the Promised Land.

moments.title: Kings gather at the Valley of Siddim
moments.text: Five kings of the plain rebelled against Chedorlaomer and came together in the Valley of Siddim, which is the Salt Sea. There they lined up for battle against four kings.

moments.title: A border of the Promised Land
moments.text: God told Moses that the Salt Sea would mark the southern end of Israel's land, and the Jordan would run down to end at the Salt Sea.

moments.title: The Jordan stops flowing
moments.text: When the priests carrying the ark touched the Jordan, the water stood still. The water flowing toward the Salt Sea was completely cut off, and the people crossed over on dry ground.

moments.title: Borders for Judah and Benjamin
moments.text: The Salt Sea became part of the borders given to the tribes. It was the eastern edge of Judah's land and marked the southern border of Benjamin's land at the mouth of the Jordan.
